paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates how the learning rate of a reward model changes over training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step," has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 1400, and features tick marks at intervals of 200 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Learning Rate", also has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to approximately 2.00e-06, and shows tick labels at intervals of approximately 0.25e-06. The plot contains a single blue line, which uses a solid style with no marker shapes. The line starts near a y-value of 0 at a training step of 0, quickly increases to peak around 2.00e-06 between steps 0 and 100, before steadily declining to approximately 0.25e-06 by the end of the x-axis at 1400 training steps. There is a legend at the top right of the plot to label the line.
